description: Lock funds in escrow using an ERC-7710 delegated budget. Requires delegationId (from a prior grant) and amount. Verifies MaxAmount, Expiry, and AllowedContracts caveats before locking. Returns escrowId and remaining delegation budget.

contractAddress.description: Contract address to call (must be in AllowedContracts)

delegationId.description: ERC-7710 delegation id authorising this spend

deliverableHash.description: Optional hash of the expected deliverable

description.description: Human-readable description of what the escrow secures

payeeId.description: Payee/agent ID receiving the escrow on release

name: pabandi_request_escrow
